query: What penalties can be imposed for assault within educational settings?
reference_answer:
Assault in Educational Institutions:
Assault in educational institutions can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and other relevant laws, including the IPC.
answer: Assault in educational settings can result in suspension or expulsion, depending on the severity and frequency of the offense. [System]
